summary: A 15 March 2024 report said Adani Group’s name was absent from the electoral-bond data released at that time. It does not establish total political donations, a BJP-specific funding relationship, or payments through other channels.
reason: Citation supports a narrow reported name-absence observation, not the retained universal zero-donation claim.
findings: An absence of a group name in one released bond dataset is not an audit of every subsidiary, person, donation channel or year.
The source predates the completion of FY2024–25 and cannot establish its donation total.
No BJP-specific donor-to-recipient matching or zero-rupee transaction is shown.
No basis for untraceable-payment or quid-pro-quo framing; juxtaposing these possibilities creates unsupported insinuation even with a disclaimer.
Retaining a documented direct funding edge misstates the evidence category.
relatedClaimStatus: A separate exact-target review also holds the Section 182 disclosure claim; other retained claims are not adjudicated by these corrections.
